facts.fact: 为什么没法向盗窃癖解释双关？他们总把东西（和话）按字面拿走——take things literally 双关
facts.anchor: Why can’t you explain puns to kleptomaniacs? They always take things literally.

facts.fact: 有好鱼笑话就 let minnow——minnow（米诺鱼）谐音 let me know
facts.anchor: If you know a good fish joke, let minnow.

facts.fact: 我有个关于纸的笑话：tearable（可撕的）谐音 terrible
facts.anchor: I know a joke about paper. It’s tearable.

facts.fact: 我有很多关于失业者的笑话，但它们 don’t work——不好笑／不起作用
facts.anchor: I’ve got loads of jokes about the unemployed, but they don’t work.

facts.fact: 我本来要讲一个时间旅行笑话，但你不喜欢它——用过去时提前告知未来反应
facts.anchor: I was going to tell a time-travelling joke, but you didn’t like it.

facts.fact: 投十个双关参加比赛看有没有进决赛：no pun in ten did——谐音 no pun intended（无意双关）
facts.anchor: I submitted ten puns to a joke-writing competition to see if any of them made the finals. Sadly, no pun in ten did.

facts.fact: 我说要写个关于眼睛最爱的部位的笑话，对方猜 Cornea？（角膜），我听成“corny 吗”，于是发怒说我的笑话很高明
facts.anchor: ‘Cornea?’ ‘How absolutely dare you, my jokes are excellent.’

facts.fact: 烂笑话与老爸笑话的区别：差一个 parent——parent 既指父母也指“来源”，apparent 的谐音
facts.anchor: What’s the difference between a bad joke and a dad joke? The difference is a parent.

facts.fact: 想扮成加里·奥德曼在《哈利·波特》里的角色去麦肯罗的化装舞会，他不让——角色是 Sirius Black，麦肯罗名言 You cannot be serious
facts.anchor: I wanted to go to John McEnroe’s fancy dress party as Gary Oldman’s character from the Harry Potter films, but John wouldn’t let me.

facts.fact: 把反问句和笑话结合会得到什么——本身即笑话，没有包袱；“Jokes with no punchline”小节三条之一
facts.anchor: What do you get when you combine a rhetorical question and a joke?
